text: ひこう　タイプ　みず　タイプは　あいしょうが　わるいぜ！

structure.jp: ひこう　タイプ　みず　タイプは
あいしょうが　わるいぜ！

patterns.name: 〜は〜が〜
patterns.span: タイプは　あいしょうが　わるい
patterns.explanation: は sets up what we are talking about, and が picks out the part of it that is being described. タイプは あいしょうが わるい = 'as for those types, the matchup is bad'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly talk that pushes the statement at the listener. わるいぜ = 'it's bad, I tell you'.
